title: Adds new `details_code` values to person document verification
summary: Adds additional details_code values to the verification[document] hash on a Person object.

migrationNotes.text: Lets you access more detailed information about the verification status of a person’s document by introducing new details_code values in the verification[document] hash of the Person object.
